description: The plot titled “Whisper fine-tunning, type = small” shows Word Error Rate (WER) values across training epochs for four “small” model configurations. The x-axis is labeled “epoch,” uses a linear scale, and runs from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at each epoch. The y-axis is labeled “WER,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 25 to 42.5 with labeled ticks every 2.5 units. Four orange lines are shown with different marker and line styles: the solid line with circle markers (“small AdaLoRA_int4”) decreases across epochs from about 35.6 at epoch 0 to about 30.5 at epoch 6, passing through approximately 34.7 (epoch 1), 33.8 (epoch 2), 32.9 (epoch 3), 32.1 (epoch 4), and 31.3 (epoch 5). The solid line with square markers (“small AdaLoRA_int8”) also trends downward from about 30.0 at epoch 0 to about 25.1 at epoch 6, with intermediate values near 29.8 (epoch 1), 28.6 (epoch 2), 28.1 (epoch 3), 27.3 (epoch 4), and 26.5 (epoch 5). The dashed line with circle markers (“small int4”) rises from about 35.6 at epoch 0 to about 40.1 at epoch 1 and peaks near 42.2 at epoch 2, then declines to about 38.7 (epoch 3), 36.3 (epoch 4), 34.0 (epoch 5), and 31.5 (epoch 6). The dashed line with square markers (“small int8”) increases from about 30.1 at epoch 0 to about 33.2 at epoch 1 and about 33.7 at epoch 2, then drops to about 29.4 (epoch 3) and about 27.3 (epoch 4), continues down to about 25.4 (epoch 5), and ends around 26.0 at epoch 6; the legend identifying these series appears in the upper-right of the plot.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) performance during the Whisper fine-tuning process, specifically for a 'small' model type. The x-axis represents the epoch, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with integer tick intervals. The y-axis represents the WER, also in a linear scale, ranging from 25.0 to 42.5, and labeled at increments of 2.5. The plot features four lines, each representing different configurations. The orange solid line with circle markers represents the 'small AdaLoRA_int4' configuration, starting at approximately 36.0 at epoch 0 and steadily decreasing to about 31 by epoch 6. The orange solid line with square markers represents 'small AdaLoRA_int8,' which begins at approximately 30.0 and decreases steadily to around 27.0. An orange dashed line with circle markers represents 'small int4,' starting at approximately 36.0, peaking around 40.0 at epoch 2, and then steadily declining to reach about 32 by epoch 6. Finally, the orange dashed line with square markers, corresponding to 'small int8,' begins at around 30.0, peaks at approximately 33.0 at epoch 2, and decreases steadily to about 28.0 at epoch 6. A legend is placed at the top right corner of the plot.
